sentences.text: The petition calls in question the proceedings in C.C.No.3404/2022, registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 354(B), 323, 504 and 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.

2. During the pendency of this petition, the parties were also before the family court in M.C.No.6507/2023, wherein the parties have settled the dispute by drawing up a memorandum of settlement, which also recognizes closure of these proceedings.

The settlement insofar as it germane to the present lis, reads as follows:
"5.

The respondent has lodged the complaint before Channapatna Police Station against the petitioner and his parents namely Kalaiah (father) and Sakamma (Mother) for the offence punishable under section 498A, 323, 504, 506 and 34 of IPC., r/w section 3 and 4 of DP Act, the same in C.C.No.3404/2022 pending on the file of Prl.Civil Judge and JMFC., Channapatna.
In view of the settlement arrived herein the respondent agree that she does not intend to further prosecute the above C.C.No.3404/2022."
3. The parties have joint memo of compromise.

The same reads as follows:
NC: 2024:KHC:20151 "JOINT MEMO "The above named petitioners and respondent No.2 respectively submits and file joint memo.

1. The petitioners filed the petition to quash the entire proceedings in C.C.No.3404/2022 and chargesheet filed by the respondent No.1 police on the file of Addl. Civil Judge & JMFC, Channapatna Town Police.
2. The respondent No.2 and petitioner No.1 settled by taking permanent alimony of Rs.4,50,000/- their dispute in mediation before the family court in M.C.No.6507/2023 and got divorce.

Already received of Rs.2,50,000/- before the family court and remaining balance amount of Rs.2,00,000/- received today before this Hon'ble court by way of DD bearing No.517066 date: 24.4.2024 drawn on Ujjivan Small Finance Bank,Channaptna from the petitioners.

3. The Respondent No.2 has received full and final amount from the petitioner No.1,
as per the settlement arrived at mediation in M.C.No.6507/2023.
The copy of the mediation agreement and decree is herewith produced with this joint memo.

4. The respondent No.2 has no objection to allow and quash the entire proceeding in C.C.No.3404/2022 and chargesheet filed by the respondent No.1 police on the file of Addl. Civil Judge & JMFC, Channapatna.

5. In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties and the offences not being against the State, I deem it appropriate to accept the same and terminate the proceedings, qua the petitioners.
6. For the aforesaid reasons, the criminal petition is disposed.
The proceedings in C.C.No.3404/2022 pending on the file of the Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Channapatna, stand quashed.
